description: One runtime for image generation, image editing, video, audio, and image-to-3D, with no API key to obtain first. The agent signs itself up once and runs all five through two calls, create and edit, on one identity and one credit balance: no provider account to open, no billing to set up. Every result returns a hosted media URL with no signature or expiry, a job id the agent can re-fetch, and a receipt for what the call cost. Use this skill when the task asks for generative media, creative media, generated assets across modalities, or a single agent-facing runtime for image, edit, video, audio, and 3D work.
